shot.continuity: one take, camera moving in every segment
shot.framing: vertical, sunlit sand fills the lower half

subject.character: big scorpion behind a stone slab in the desert, rolled contract under one claw, mic at his mouth
subject.physicality: armoured and unhurried, claws open and close on every word, tail up, tip twitching
subject.anti_action: signs the contract with a flourish, dipping the sting like a fountain pen, dead serious
subject.consistency: same scorpion, same slab; the beetle is the only other animal

props.contract: one rolled contract: unrolled, signed, handed over, then unrolls down the dune
props.coin: one coin lent, two brought back, a third hidden in the beetle's chest

environment: open desert at midday, pale dunes, a sun-bleached stone slab
lighting: hard midday sun — pale sand and stone are the brightest surfaces, short black shadow under him

audio.pacing: four separate sentences, each in its own beat with a 0.15 s breath between: 0.6-1.4, 1.55-2.25, 2.4-2.85, 3.0-3.5. Each finished before the next begins. Nothing after 3.5
audio.pronunciation: «Без отказа.» ends on a clear open -А. Never «без отказ»
audio.lip_sync: mouthparts move on every syllable, voice comes from the scorpion

timeline.a: a claw slams the rolled contract onto the hot stone, sand jumping. Silent
timeline.cam: slab-level lens under the claw, rising

timeline.a: spoken calmly. Both claws sweep the contract open over the slab
timeline.cam: pushes in from the claws to his face

timeline.a: a sentence of its own, breath before and after, finished on the open -А. The sting signs the paper
timeline.cam: cranes up with the sting and back to the paper

timeline.a: spoken calmly. He turns the paper round to face the lens
spoken calmly. The claw taps the stone twice beside the paper
timeline.cam: pushes in low on the tapping claw

timeline.a: silent from here on. A dung beetle in a cap steps up, takes the paper and shakes the claw
timeline.cam: drifts low to the beetle at the slab edge

timeline.a: the scorpion slides one gold coin over the stone; the beetle grabs it and hugs it
timeline.cam: tracks the coin sliding over the slab

timeline.a: the beetle turns to leave, rolling the coin ahead of him over the sand
timeline.cam: follows the rolling coin away from the slab

timeline.a: the contract in his other leg unrolls behind him down the dune
timeline.cam: cranes up as the paper keeps unrolling

timeline.a: the paper snaps taut — its far end still pinned under the scorpion's claw
timeline.cam: whips back along the paper to the claw

timeline.a: the scorpion reels the contract in; the beetle is dragged backwards to the slab
the beetle sets two gold coins on the stone, pushes them over and spreads his legs
timeline.cam: pushes in on the two coins

timeline.a: the sting comes down, dips inside the beetle's chest and lifts out a third coin
timeline.cam: pushes in low on the sting lifting the coin

timeline.a: the beetle bolts away. The scorpion lays all three coins in a row, tail tip twitching
timeline.cam: follows the running beetle, then back to the coins

negative_prompt: two sentences crowded into one beat, one sentence running into the next, speech after 3.6 s, saying «без отказ», a swallowed final vowel, visible cuts, the beetle speaking, a second scorpion, drawn-out delivery, duplicate props, floating objects, dim scene, dark foreground, locked-off camera, slow camera move, snap zoom, whip pan, lettering on the paper, subtitles, watermark, English speech
